title: OSI 소식
bodyHtml:
울온의 서비스 중지에 관한 루머를 잠재울 소식이라고 합니다. OSI 울온 개발진이 "퍼블리시팀"과 "UO에 관한 다른 큰 계획팀(확장팩을 준비하는 정도로 생각하면 될 것 같습니다)" 으로 나뉘어졌다는건 소식을 들어서 알고 계시겠죠? 어찌됐든 이번에 울온 개발진에서 메인 프로그래머와 메인 아티스트를 새로 영입했다고 합니다. 그리고 채용 모집을 계속하고 있다고 하네요. 온라인게임 SWG(스타워즈갤럭시)측에 스카웃되었던 초기 울온 개발자 SunSword도 다시 오리진으로 돌아온걸 보면, 확실히 무언가를 분주히 준비하고 있는 것 같군요.

다음은 원문입니다.

Question: With a little observation and logic, it's to "quell a rumor about UO's demise".
They just got through hiring a bunch of new people. They're splitting the team into a "publish" team and a "next big thing" team. We know that they're currently working on something major, but they're not ready to start marketing it yet.

Companies getting ready to shut down don't go hiring a bunch of new people. Sure it's possible that EA might pull the plug suddenly, but there is absolutely no evidence that's happening. "Huh, we're only getting $25 million in revenue from UO. Think we should pull the plug?"

Answer: Very true! We have, in fact, recently hired a large number of programmers, a Lead Programmer, and a Lead Artist. And, if you check out our Employment page, you'll see we're not done hiring people to work specifically on Ultima Online. These people certainly wouldn't be moving here from other states if they felt the UO service was shringing at all. No, in fact we're continue to plan UO's long-term growth. I wish I could talk about UO's Next Big Thing that you mentioned to help everyone understand some of the fantastic plans we have in mind, but those long-term plans are still "hush hush." Rest assured, the moment we can let that "NBT" cat out of the bag, we will!

=========
Keith "Sannio" Quinn
Community Relations
Ultima Online (www.uo.com)
Origin Systems
